sourceClaim: Retain foundational programs, select complementary work around finite time and recovery, and control the planned session duration. These sources do not prescribe the numerical admission algorithm.
appDecisions: Within protected coordinated plans, automatic supplemental/variety choices follow declared program work and prerequisite support. Explicit or legacy pending IDs remain mandatory.

Unadmitted automatic additions are optionalStandby metadata, not physical prescriptions, debt, completion or credit. An admitted written prescription that is skipped or partly performed retains normal unfinished-work meaning.
Only declared program patterns and actual prerequisite support inform observed core sweep size; incidental optional activity does not establish a mandatory core cadence.

Protected-plan fitting omits the final following rest and restores the preceding transition when another movement is added. Genuine round intervals, set/rep/rest targets and conservative per-movement setup allowance remain unchanged.
Explicit saved Major family priorities are not silently demoted into optional standby. Admission does not remove saved priorities or genuine pending work.
limits: This does not curate a complete core or developing-program queue, establish biological minimum frequency or close the rotation release gate.
Oversized core selections still cause reduced returns; recorded diagnostic improvements are not physical outcome claims.
Legacy unprotected fitting and default behavior remain unchanged.
Self-paced work duration remains a planning estimate; timers do not prove actual physical completion.
